entityDescription:
Parsimoni - French software developer with exclusive focus on creating software for the satellite industry.

Our goal is to make satellites more valuable through the use of SpaceOS
- deploy more software packages on shared payload satellites
- reduce the size of the software package - faster upload / updates; use less memory and processor resources - maximize the power of the on board compute chip
- facilitate edge computing on board the satellite - process the data in space and send only the useful insights to the ground
- increase the utilization of the currently often under utilized in orbit compute capacities
- standardize: engineers develop their space software for SpaceOS, SpaceOS takes care of the integration with the satellite (no more need to develop software one by one for each satellite)
- secure by design architecture - high level of cybersecurity built in (memory safe programming language; formal verification; very small attach surface)

Partnerships with Thales and OHB. Winner of the 2024 Airbus Innovation Award at the Paris Space Week. Recipient of the CNES Space Ticket. Incubated by ESA BIC and the Creative Destruction Lab Space Stream

In orbit since March 2025

entityDescription:
RT-RK is a premium embedded software development house in the Southeast Europe, with a focus on consumer electronics and infotainment systems. The company was founded in 1991, inheriting the former FTN-IRAM with mostly domestic clients in oil and gas, and military industries. With the rise of semiconductor industry and smaller silicon footprints, RT-RK has begun its decades long worldwide journey in the consumer electronics industry. Strong ties with the clients, trust and confidence in the company’s know-how and increasing engineering capacities, has turned RT-RK into dynamic near shore development centers of silicon vendor and consumer electronics companies that have endeavored to imagine or reimagine their products over the past three decades.
In the early 2010s the engineering power, competence, and potential of the company caught attention of the Austrian company TTTech, famous for its time triggered technology, the backbone of safety in the networking, automotive, industrial, and aerospace industries. Becoming a near shore development center for TTTech and subsequently TTTech Auto has drawn the company deep into the automotive grade software development and processes. The era of cooperation with TTTech Auto has ended with the biggest engineering carve out of RT-RK yet, in favor of TTTech Auto’s expansion in the region.
RT-RK currently employs 600+ engineers on four locations.

description: Know Center (KC) is Austria’s leading research center for trustworthy AI. As a renowned research organization with excellent science team, large partner network, successful business venture, and proven organizational structure, we apply for COMET funding for our ambitious research program on Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence & Data for Sustainability, Industry 4.0, and Life Sciences. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a universal tool, providing opportunities for solving global challenges and generating massive economic benefits in the twin green & digital transformation. However, the European population distrusts AI & Data. Europe must regain technology and data sovereignty and develop a vision of AI based on humanistic values to restore trust in the digital transformation. 360-degree vision for Trustworthy AI & Data. We have derived our 360-degree vision from EU’s definition of Trustworthy AI (TAI). Our interdisciplinary research will investigate technical robustness, safety, privacy, data governance, transparency, diversity, non-discrimination, fairness, accountability, as well as human agency and oversight. Our vision develops these requirements into scientific challenges and research fields and identifies application areas in business ecosystems, which together form a holistic and interdisciplinary research program for Austrian leadership in Trustworthy AI & Data.
entityDescription:
Know Center Research GmbH (KC) is Austria’s leading center for trustworthy AI research. With an outstanding team of scientists, a robust partner network, successful industry collaborations, and a proven organizational structure, Know-Center is committed to advancing the frontiers of data science and artificial intelligence (AI). Our current application for COMET funding is centered on a visionary research program addressing Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (TAI) & Data for Sustainability, Industry 4.0, and Life Sciences.
AI has emerged as a transformative technology, capable of addressing global challenges and driving the twin green and digital transformation, resulting in significant economic opportunities. Yet, there remains a pervasive mistrust of AI and data within the European population. Restoring this trust is critical, and Europe must take the lead in developing AI grounded in humanistic values to ensure technology and data sovereignty.
To address this, Know Center has developed a comprehensive 360-degree vision for Trustworthy AI & Data, aligned with the European Union’s definition of TAI. Our interdisciplinary research agenda will focus on the critical dimensions of AI: technical robustness, safety, privacy, data governance, transparency, diversity, non-discrimination, fairness, accountability, and human agency and oversight. We aim to transform these requirements into scientific challenges and new research fields, while identifying strategic application areas in business ecosystems that establish Austria as a leader in Trustworthy AI & Data.
The research program is structured around six core research areas—Data Management for AI, Data Privacy for AI, Methods & Algorithms for AI, Human-Centric AI, Fair AI, and Digital Transformation Design—each conducting cutting-edge research on fundamental aspects of TAI & Data. Additionally, three strategic projects will integrate this interdisciplinary research along the AI lifecycle, culminating in the development of open-source software frameworks: KnowAIDE, KnowTWINS, and KnowCERTIFAI. Furthermore, twelve applied research projects will foster AI specialization in three critical business ecosystems, in collaboration with a consortium of 40 company partners.
The success of this initiative is bolstered by a strong alliance of 26 scientific partners, supported by a network of over 280 European and 20 international leading scientific institutions. This extensive collaboration will enable us to drive impactful research and technology transfer to three key business ecosystems: (1) Environment, Energy, and Sustainability, (2) Production, Automation, and Logistics (Industry 4.0), and (3) Medicine, Pharmaceutics, and Health (Life Sciences). Our work will contribute significantly to Austria’s position in achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the EU Green Deal.

With an outstanding team of scientists, a robust partner network, successful industry collaborations, and a proven organizational structure, Know-Center is committed to advancing the frontiers of data science and artificial intelligence (AI). Our current application for COMET funding is centered on a visionary research program addressing Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (TAI) & Data for Sustainability, Industry 4.0, and Life Sciences.
AI has emerged as a transformative technology, capable of addressing global challenges and driving the twin green and digital transformation, resulting in significant economic opportunities. Yet, there remains a pervasive mistrust of AI and data within the European population. Restoring this trust is critical, and Europe must take the lead in developing AI grounded in humanistic values to ensure technology and data sovereignty.
To address this, Know Center has developed a comprehensive 360-degree vision for Trustworthy AI & Data, aligned with the European Union’s definition of TAI. Our interdisciplinary research agenda will focus on the critical dimensions of AI: technical robustness, safety, privacy, data governance, transparency, diversity, non-discrimination, fairness, accountability, and human agency and oversight. We aim to transform these requirements into scientific challenges and new research fields, while identifying strategic application areas in business ecosystems that establish Austria as a leader in Trustworthy AI & Data.
The research program is structured around six core research areas—Data Management for AI, Data Privacy for AI, Methods & Algorithms for AI, Human-Centric AI, Fair AI, and Digital Transformation Design—each conducting cutting-edge research on fundamental aspects of TAI & Data. Additionally, three strategic projects will integrate this interdisciplinary research along the AI lifecycle, culminating in the development of open-source software frameworks: KnowAIDE, KnowTWINS, and KnowCERTIFAI. Furthermore, twelve applied research projects will foster AI specialization in three critical business ecosystems, in collaboration with a consortium of 40 company partners.
The success of this initiative is bolstered by a strong alliance of 26 scientific partners, supported by a network of over 280 European and 20 international leading scientific institutions. This extensive collaboration will enable us to drive impactful research and technology transfer to three key business ecosystems: (1) Environment, Energy, and Sustainability, (2) Production, Automation, and Logistics (Industry 4.0), and (3) Medicine, Pharmaceutics, and Health (Life Sciences). Our work will contribute significantly to Austria’s position in achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the EU Green Deal.

entityDescription: Masaryk Memorial Cancer Institute (MMCI) is the largest cancercenter in the Czech Republic in terms of the number of primarily treated adult patients with solid tumors and the provision of preventive cancer care. MMCI is also a member of ERN network for rare adult solid cancers EURACAN and for genetic tumor risk syndromes GENTURIS. MMCI is providing health care services, research and education in the areas of prevention, diagnosis and treatment of solid tumors. MMCI is affiliated to Masaryk University, within which it cooperates with two other university hospitals, namely University Hospital Brno and St. Anne‘s University Hospital. entityDescription:
Carboneg Group s.r.o.

Carboneg stands for the innovative synergy between future-proof agricultural practices and environmental responsibility. By assisting farmers in transitioning to regenerative agriculture, Carboneg plays a key role in the development of sustainable and resilient food systems. Farmers engaged in the Carboneg program are financially compensated for their contributions to capturing carbon in the soil, enhancing water retention, and promoting increased biodiversity. In terms of revenue generation, Carboneg is harnessing the potential of carbon credit sales to cater to its corporate clientele. To be able to tackle the needs of local environments, ecosystems and communities, Carboneg works closely with its local Agents. Agents are responsible for signing up and onboarding farmers for the Carboneg program. Through its Agent network, Carboneg is currently present on four continents with farmers and ranchers operating their livelihoods on more than 150000 hectares of land. As the world of agriculture gets increasingly challenged by the loss of biodiversity, distorted water cycles and ever more demanding food supply chains, the scale of needed transformation is unprecedented. Carboneg is now looking for new Agents to be part of this pioneering change. This document unfolds the details about the synergy between the impact Carboneg is making directly and the opportunities it creates for its critical stakeholders, farmers and Carboneg Agents alike. The Manual serves as the primary guideline to successfully operate the Carboneg program. The mission of Carboneg is to contribute to carbon negativity and healthier soil. The vision of Carboneg is to sequester 1 billion tonnes of CO2 in the soil by the year 2030. Carboneg was born in the Czech Republic in 2021 as a spin-off project of the employee benefits service company Benefit Management Ltd. Carboneg as well as Benefit Management Ltd was founded by Mr Vaclav Kurel who currently serves as Carboneg’s Chief Executive. After almost half a year of its existence, Carboneg managed to attract around 27 farmers into its regenerative farming program covering around 3 000 Ha of land in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. In 2022 Carboneg expanded its operations further abroad, specifically through partnerships in Kyrgyzstan and Romania. By 2023, Carboneg extended its team to 17 members covering all key functions and is currently well established for further international development. By the end of the year 2023, Carboneg aims to cover the total area of 250000 hectares of cropland and pastures under its flagship Program.

entityDescription:
Guardian Space aims to transform how communities and professionals manage risks and respond to disasters through its innovative community hubs. These hubs act as localized networks that connect residents, businesses, professionals, and insurers, facilitating the sharing of resources, collaboration, and access to real-time disaster intelligence.
Under the Community Hubs umbrella, we offer tailored solutions for both individuals and professionals:
CommunityHub.me equips individuals and small businesses with tools to find insurance coverage, manage claims, and facilitate payouts. Partnering with insurance providers, this platform incentivizes risk reduction through discounted rates and community-based risk diffusion, ensuring users obtain the most appropriate coverage.
CommunityHub.pro is designed for EMTs, firefighters, police, and other experts who require advanced tools and dashboards to monitor and mitigate risks. It provides real-time insights across 18 disaster types, enabling informed decisions that enhance community resilience.
On the insurance side, our Insurance EVENT360 Dashboard offers a comprehensive view of community risks and claims. Insurers can track incidents, assess claims efficiently, and identify opportunities for risk reduction, fostering collaboration with communities to create tailored insurance solutions.
Guardian Space promotes a collaborative approach to disaster management and risk reduction, equipping communities and professionals with the necessary resources and information to build safer, more resilient environments.
Our success is supported by collaborations with key partners such as the European Space Agency (ESA) and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). Our innovations have been recognized by institutions including the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) and the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA).

Green Elephant Biotech is a start-up founded in 2021 by Dr. Joel Eichmann and Felix Wollenhaupt in Giessen, Germany. Green Elephant Biotech aims to offer both academic institutions and the manufacturing industry a way to reduce their carbon footprint while enabling process intensification by developing and distributing novel, technologically innovative, plant-based, single-use laboratory consumables.
Green Elephant is a worldwide pioneer in using the plant-based polymer Polylactic Acid (PLA) for labware. The company enables the production of novel cell and gene therapies and biopharmaceuticals by offering efficient and scalable cell cultivation devices and consumables. In doing so, they contribute to a healthier world for both people and the planet.
